import json,torch
from monai.engines import SupervisedEvaluator
from monai.utils import ForwardMode
class PublicExampleNetwork(torch.nn.Module):
    def forward(self,image):
        print('PUBLIC_FORWARD',json.dumps({'training':self.training,'grad_enabled':torch.is_grad_enabled()}),flush=True)
        return image*2
image=torch.tensor([[1.0,2.0]],requires_grad=True)
mode=ForwardMode.TRAIN
print('PUBLIC_EVALUATOR_MODE',str(mode),flush=True)
evaluator=SupervisedEvaluator(device=torch.device('cpu'),val_data_loader=[{'image':image,'label':torch.zeros_like(image)}],epoch_length=1,network=PublicExampleNetwork(),decollate=False,mode=mode)
evaluator.run()
prediction=evaluator.state.output['pred']
print('PUBLIC_EVALUATOR_RESULT',json.dumps({'mode':str(mode),'prediction':prediction.detach().tolist(),'requires_grad':prediction.requires_grad}),flush=True)
if mode in ('train',ForwardMode.TRAIN):
    gradient=torch.autograd.grad(prediction.sum(),image)[0]
    print('PUBLIC_INPUT_GRADIENT',gradient.tolist(),flush=True)
